scope: Durable serial execution/observation/repair/resume with real bounded CSV queries, visible task steps and Windows local-alpha upgrade; natural-language full-interface authoring deferred
observations: Paused checkpoint and intermediate failure logs are retained unchanged. Legacy single-step CLI continuation and the default interface bundle missing workflow.mjs were fixed; final full suites passed.

Real DeepSeek used only fictional CSV in a fresh root: query A=5/B=4, observe actual receipt, save report, final answer; three serial requests, no retry. Existing four business databases were unchanged during this trial.
Original source service was already stopped. Data was backed up before cold start; row digests of all 30 existing tables match. Two workflow tables were added.

The failure/repair path is demonstrated with deterministic model fixtures and real local executors. The one real model sample was successful without a failed query; it does not establish universal semantic reliability.
limits: Queries use read-only SQLite on explicitly attached CSV in a bounded in-memory database; no arbitrary generated host programs. Ordinary SQLite numeric semantics are not exact financial arithmetic.
Tool receipts expose bounded result samples, with truncation markers. A saved report does not independently prove the correctness of its prose. User review remains appropriate.

Continuous model judgments pause after eight steps; explicit resume allows up to 64 judgments per task. This is a task-loop resource boundary, not an account quota. Network errors are not retried automatically.
Memory/follow-up proposals are applied only with a final validated response. Restart preserves progress but does not automatically call the model. Stopped turns cannot be resumed.
The default view shows the latest 12 steps; earlier action artifacts remain available. It displays public summaries and actual receipts, not hidden internal chain of thought.
Unsigned Windows x64 local alpha; this machine only. Native restrictions are defense in depth, not a universal hostile community-code sandbox. Scheduler requires the local machine/service running.
next: User trial of the local alpha. Natural-language whole-interface authoring remains deferred by user instruction; other platform expansions are not counted as complete.
